summary: Goldman Sachs Private Middle Market Credit II LLC filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Goldman Sachs Private Middle Market Credit II SPV II LLC, entered into a First Amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement on September 24, 2026. The amendment extends the Scheduled Termination Date of the JPMorgan Chase-administered credit facility to January 15, 2027. No pricing, stake, or premium terms are stated. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are disclosed.
